input: I watch quite a lot of TV. Recently I watched four seasons of Trying in three days because I liked the family relationships. I also watch AI short dramas to unwind.
question: How much time do you spend watching TV?

key_issues.message: 题目问“花多少时间”，回答只给了“quite a lot”和“三天看完四季”这样的间接信息，没有直接给出频率或时长（如每天几小时、每周几次），答题不够直接。
三个句子是并列罗列，缺少连接和主次；先给总述、再举例、再补充另一类节目会更清晰。
“family relationships”可以，但“family dynamics”在描述剧中家庭成员互动时更地道，属于升级而非错误。
“AI short dramas”表意可懂，但“short AI-generated dramas”更准确自然，属于升级而非错误。
“I watch quite a lot of TV”偏书面/笼统，口语中更常说“I watch a fair amount of TV”或“I'm a big TV watcher”，但原句并不算错。

feedback.optimization_summary: 原回答语法正确、意思清楚，因此只做轻微调整：保留全部个人事实和原有措辞，仅把“family relationships”和“AI short dramas”作为可选升级建议列出，最终答案未采纳这两处升级，仍使用原词。
feedback.final_upgraded_answer: I watch quite a lot of TV. Recently I watched four seasons of Trying in three days because I liked the family relationships. I also watch AI short dramas to unwind.
feedback.reference_answer: Honestly, not that much these days — maybe an hour or so in the evening, and even then it's usually just something light while I'm having dinner. I used to binge-watch series for hours when I was a student, but once I started working, I found I just didn't have the energy or the time. Now I'd rather watch a documentary or a football match at the weekend, something I can actually pay attention to. If I'm honest, my screen time has mostly shifted to my phone, which is probably worse, but at least I can stop anytime.
feedback.reference_angle_summary: 独立主线：以“现在看得少、过去看很多”的时间变化对比展开，并自然带出注意力与屏幕时间转移的反思；示例不代表用户经历。
feedback.content_diagnosis: 回答直接回应了“看多少电视”这一话题，用“quite a lot”给出总量，并用“三天看完四季Trying”和“看AI短剧放松”两个具体例子支撑，相关性好。但缺少直接的时间量（每天/每周几小时），展开偏薄，两个例子之间也没有说明哪个是主要习惯。
feedback.structure_diagnosis: 信息顺序为：总量→具体剧集例子→另一类节目。逻辑基本可懂，但三句之间只有“Recently”和“also”连接，缺少“总体—举例—补充”的层次标记，读起来像清单而非连贯回答。
feedback.optimization_advice: 建议在开头直接补一个时间量，例如每天或每周看多久，让“quite a lot”有具体支撑；然后说明Trying是你最近集中追的剧，AI短剧是你日常放松的方式，用“On top of that”或“When I just want to switch off”把两类观看区分开。这些细节需要你自己补充，我不替你编造。
